title: AirPlay
description: Your iPhone's screen on the central display, by AirPlay screen mirroring, while parked. Open the app, disconnect CarPlay, join the car's Wi-Fi, then on the iPhone: Control Centre, Screen Mirroring, the car's Bluetooth name (BMW 12345).
